findings.finding: The review distinguishes the permanently influenced3-11S region from the seasonally variable northern extension. The Figure1 arrows are explicitly suspected major/minor pathways during the NE monsoon.
findings.consequence: A new regional cartographic convention could be evaluated from this figure separately from the existing page27 theoretical-transit statement. Do not label it an observed axis or whole-current annual geometry.

findings.locator: p2 section2, paragraph beginning Along the East African coast
findings.finding: Recognition out to160-200km offshore, velocity maximum20-90km offshore and most transport within120km are different descriptions attributed to older studies.
findings.consequence: Do not combine these into a paired current width, seasonal envelope or three independent observations. Recover original Bell1969 and Swallow1991 methods before any additional dimension admission.

findings.finding: SE monsoonJun-Oct extends northward influence across the equator, while NE monsoonDec-Mar restricts its northern surface reach near2-3S.
findings.consequence: Calendar context is distinct from dated endpoints and annual extrema. Figure1 is an NE monsoon schematic only.
